en.headline: Liu and Chong attend Asian Para Games opening to support Hong Kong athletes
en.dek: The undersecretary for culture, sports and tourism and the new commissioner for sports met the Hong Kong, China delegation in Nagoya and will watch events in the coming days.
body: Under Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Liu Chun and newly appointed Commissioner for Sports Chong Man-ting attended the opening ceremony of the fifth Asian Para Games in Nagoya on Sunday and met members of the Hong Kong, China delegation.

The Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau said on social media that the officials also joined an official welcome reception, where they met representatives of the China Disabled Persons' Federation and the Chinese Consul General in Nagoya, and visited the Chinese and Macao delegations.

Liu and Chong are expected to visit different venues over the next few days to watch Hong Kong athletes compete and cheer them on in person. The bureau said members of the public can follow the Games live on RTHK TV 31 or at designated viewing stations in sports centres across the 18 districts.

zh.headline: 劉震及莊敏婷出席亞殘運開幕式為港隊打氣
zh.dek: 文化體育及旅遊局副局長劉震和新任體育專員莊敏婷到名古屋與中國香港代表團見面，了解住宿及備戰情況，未來數日將到場館觀賽。
body: 第五屆亞洲殘疾人運動會周日在日本名古屋開幕。文化體育及旅遊局副局長劉震和新任體育專員莊敏婷出席開幕式，並到當地與中國香港代表團見面，了解運動員的住宿和備戰情況，為他們打氣。
局方在社交網頁表示，劉震和莊敏婷亦參加官方歡迎酒會，期間見到中國殘疾人聯合會代表及中國駐名古屋總領事，並探訪中國體育代表團及中國澳門體育代表團。
兩人隨後數天將會走訪不同場館，觀看港隊運動員出戰的項目，在現場為他們打氣。當局表示，市民可透過港台電視31，以及康文署轄下十八區指定體育館設立的觀賞站，直擊亞殘運賽事，支持港隊運動員。
